<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0"/>
<title>ProActivators — Building State of the Art Leaders</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"/>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&family=DM+Sans:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;1,300;1,400&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
:root{
  --black:#050505;
  --deep:#0b0b0b;
  --surface:#141414;
  --surface2:#1c1c1c;
  --off-white:#f0ebe0;
  --steel:#888;
  --steel-lt:#aaa;
  --blue:#3ab4f2;
  --blue-dim:rgba(58,180,242,0.1);
  --blue-border:rgba(58,180,242,0.22);
  --border:rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--black);color:var(--off-white);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:3px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--blue)}
.bebas{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.04em}
.mono{font-family:'Space Mono',monospace}


/* NAV */
nav{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:300;
  height:72px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:0 5vw;transition:background .5s,border-bottom .5s;
}
nav.scrolled{background:rgba(5,5,5,.97);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.nav-logo img{height:30px;display:block}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:2.8rem;list-style:none}
.nav-links a{
  font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;font-size:.6rem;
  letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--steel);text-decoration:none;transition:color .2s;
}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--blue)}
.nav-cta{
  font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.16em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--black);background:var(--blue);
  border:none;padding:.65rem 1.7rem;cursor:pointer;
  transition:opacity .2s,transform .15s;
}
.nav-cta:hover{opacity:.85;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.nav-hamburger{
  display:none;
  flex-direction:column;gap:5px;
  background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:.4rem;
  z-index:310;
}
.nav-hamburger span{
  display:block;width:24px;height:2px;
  background:var(--off-white);transition:all .3s;
}
.nav-hamburger.open span:nth-child(1){transform:rotate(45deg) translate(5px,5px)}
.nav-hamburger.open span:nth-child(2){opacity:0;transform:translateX(-8px)}
.nav-hamburger.open span:nth-child(3){transform:rotate(-45deg) translate(5px,-5px)}
.mobile-menu{
  display:none;
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:290;
  background:rgba(5,5,5,.97);
  flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  gap:2.5rem;
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;
  pointer-events:none;
}
.mobile-menu.open{
  display:flex;opacity:1;pointer-events:all;
}
.mobile-menu a{
  font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;
  font-size:clamp(36px,10vw,56px);
  letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--off-white);
  text-decoration:none;transition:color .2s;
}
.mobile-menu a:hover{color:var(--blue)}
.mobile-menu .mobile-cta{
  font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;font-size:.75rem;
  letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--black);background:var(--blue);
  border:none;padding:1rem 3rem;cursor:pointer;margin-top:1rem;
  font-size:.72rem;
}
@media(max-width:768px){
  .nav-links,.nav-cta{display:none}
  .nav-hamburger{display:flex}
}


/* HERO — pure typographic, no photo */
#hero{
  min-height:100vh;position:relative;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;
  padding:100px 6vw 120px;
  overflow:hidden;
  max-width:100vw;
}
/* Subtle grid atmosphere */
.hero-grid{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(58,180,242,0.04) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(58,180,242,0.04) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:72px 72px;
}
/* Blue glow orb */
.hero-glow{
  position:absolute;z-index:0;
  right:-10vw;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  width:60vw;height:80vh;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(58,180,242,0.08) 0%,transparent 65%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.hero-glow2{
  position:absolute;z-index:0;
  left:-5vw;bottom:0;
  width:40vw;height:40vh;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at bottom left,rgba(58,180,242,0.05) 0%,transparent 70%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
/* Vertical accent line */
.hero-line{
  position:absolute;left:5vw;top:0;bottom:0;z-index:0;
  width:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,rgba(58,180,242,0.3) 30%,rgba(58,180,242,0.3) 70%,transparent);
}
.hero-content{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:1000px}
/* eyebrow removed */
.hero-h1{
  font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;
  font-size:clamp(48px,13vw,200px);
  line-height:.9;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--off-white);
  opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .9s .2s forwards;
}
.hero-h1 .blue{color:var(--blue)}
/* The big question — offset right */
/* hero-question replaced by hero-lower */
.hero-q-text{
  font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;
  font-size:clamp(28px,3.5vw,52px);
  line-height:1;letter-spacing:.04em;
  color:rgba(240,235,224,0.35);
  max-width:520px;
}
.hero-q-text span{color:rgba(240,235,224,0.7)}
.hero-actions{
  display:flex;gap:1rem;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;
  padding-top:.3rem;
}
.btn-blue{
  font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.17em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--black);background:var(--blue);
  border:none;padding:1.05rem 2.6rem;cursor:pointer;
  transition:opacity .2s,transform .15s,box-shadow .2s;
  text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
}
.btn-blue:hover{opacity:.85;transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 36px rgba(58,180,242,.25)}
.btn-outline{
  font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.17em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(240,235,224,.55);background:transparent;
  border:1px solid rgba(240,235,224,.15);padding:1.05rem 2.6rem;cursor:pointer;
  transition:border-color .2s,color .2s;text-decoration:none;
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;
}
.btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue)}
/* Scroll indicator */
/* Cycling word — slide in from right, hold, snap out left */
.hero-cycle-wrap{
  display:inline-block;
  overflow:hidden;
  position:relative;
  /* Reserve space so layout doesn't jump */
  min-width:3ch;
}
.hero-cycle{
  color:rgba(240,235,224,0.22);
  display:inline-block;
  /* Default: visible and in place (first word on load) */
  transform:translateX(0);
  opacity:1;
  will-change:transform, opacity;
}
/* While swapping — word is off-screen right, invisible */
.hero-cycle.offscreen{
  transform:translateX(120%);
  opacity:0;
  transition:none;
}
/* Entering: slides in from right */
.hero-cycle.entering{
  animation:slideInRight 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) forwards;
}
/* Exiting: snaps out fast to the left */
.hero-cycle.exiting{
  animation:snapOutLeft 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.6,0,0.8,0) forwards;
}
@keyframes slideInRight{
  0%   { transform:translateX(120%); opacity:0; }
  40%  { opacity:1; }
  100% { transform:translateX(0);    opacity:1; }
}
@keyframes snapOutLeft{
  0%   { transform:translateX(0);     opacity:1; }
  100% { transform:translateX(-115%); opacity:0; }
}
/* THRIVING — slow subtle glow breathe */
.hero-thriving{
  color:var(--blue);
  display:inline-block;
  animation:glowBreathe 4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes glowBreathe{
  0%,100% { text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(58,180,242,0.15) }
  50%     { text-shadow: 0 0 28px rgba(58,180,242,0.55), 0 0 60px rgba(58,180,242,0.15) }
}
/* Mission statement — sits between headline and sub copy */
.hero-mission{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.4rem;
  margin:2rem 0 2.2rem;
  opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .8s .45s forwards;
}
.hero-mission span{
  font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;
  font-size:clamp(13px,1.8vw,22px);
  letter-spacing:.14em;
  color:var(--blue);
  white-space:nowrap;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  text-align:center;
}
.hero-mission-line{
  flex:1;height:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(to right,rgba(58,180,242,0.4),transparent);
}
.hero-mission-line:last-child{
  background:linear-gradient(to left,rgba(58,180,242,0.4),transparent);
}
/* Lower section — sub text + buttons */
.hero-lower{
  display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;
  gap:2.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;
  opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .9s .6s forwards;
}
.hero-sub-text{
  font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;
  font-size:clamp(14px,1.6vw,18px);
  color:rgba(240,235,224,0.6);
  line-height:1.75;
  max-width:420px;
}
.hero-scroll{
  position:absolute;bottom:2.5rem;left:5vw;z-index:1;
  font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.2em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--steel);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem;
  opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .8s .8s forwards;
}
.hero-scroll::after{
  content:'';display:inline-block;width:1px;height:36px;
  background:linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--blue),transparent);
  animation:scrollPulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes scrollPulse{0%,100%{opacity:.4;transform:scaleY(1)}50%{opacity:1;transform:scaleY(1.2)}}
@media(max-width:768px){
  #hero{padding:90px 5vw 80px}
  /* Headline: use vw-only so it ALWAYS fits the screen width */
  .hero-h1{font-size:12vw;line-height:.93;letter-spacing:.01em}
  .hero-mission{margin:1rem 0 1.2rem;gap:.6rem}
  /* Mission: shrink and allow wrap */
  .hero-mission span{font-size:2.8vw;letter-spacing:.1em;white-space:normal;text-align:center;line-height:1.5}
  .hero-mission-line{display:none}
  .hero-lower{flex-direction:column;gap:1.5rem;margin-top:0}
  .hero-sub-text{font-size:14px;max-width:100%}
  .hero-actions{width:100%;flex-direction:column}
  .btn-blue,.btn-outline{width:100%;justify-content:center;padding:.95rem 1.5rem}
  .hero-line{display:none}
  .hero-scroll{display:none}
}
/* Extra small phones */
@media(max-width:380px){
  .hero-h1{font-size:11vw}
  .hero-mission span{font-size:2.5vw}
}
/* thriving glow — no overflow issues */
.hero-bottom{
  position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:2;height:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(58,180,242,.2),transparent);
}


/* TICKER */
.ticker{background:var(--blue);padding:.72rem 0;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap}
.ticker-track{display:inline-flex;animation:ticker 28s linear infinite}
.ticker-track span{
  font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;font-size:.58rem;
  letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--black);padding:0 2.5rem;
}
.ticker-track .dot{color:rgba(0,0,0,.35);padding:0}
@keyframes ticker{0%{transform:translateX(0)}100%{transform:translateX(-50%)}}


/* SHARED */
.section-pad{padding:130px 5vw}
.section-divider{border:none;border-top:1px solid var(--border);margin:0}
.label{
  font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.28em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue);margin-bottom:1.6rem;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;
}
.label-num{color:var(--steel);font-size:.57rem}
.section-h2{
  font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;
  font-size:clamp(44px,7vw,100px);
  line-height:.93;letter-spacing:.03em;color:var(--off-white);
}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .8s ease,transform .8s ease}
.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}


/* MANIFESTO */
#manifesto{background:var(--deep);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.manifesto-inner{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:3fr 2fr;gap:5rem;align-items:center;
}
.manifesto-text{
  font-size:clamp(17px,1.7vw,21px);line-height:1.8;color:rgba(240,235,224,.72);
}
.manifesto-text p+p{margin-top:1.4rem}
.manifesto-text strong{color:var(--off-white);font-style:italic}
.manifesto-quote{
  font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;
  font-size:clamp(32px,4.5vw,62px);
  line-height:.97;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--blue);
  border-left:3px solid var(--blue);padding-left:2rem;
}




/* TESTIMONIALS */
#testimonials{background:var(--black);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
#testimonials::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 50% 50%,rgba(58,180,242,0.04) 0%,transparent 70%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.testimonials-inner{padding:130px 5vw;position:relative;z-index:1}
.testimonials-header{margin-bottom:5rem}
.testimonials-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  gap:1px;
  background:var(--border);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
}
.testimonial-card{
  background:var(--surface);
  padding:2.8rem 2.4rem;
  position:relative;
  transition:background 0.3s;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1.6rem;
}
.testimonial-card:hover{background:rgba(58,180,242,0.04)}
.testimonial-quote-mark{
  font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;
  font-size:5rem;line-height:.7;
  color:var(--blue);opacity:0.25;
  display:block;
  margin-bottom:-.5rem;
}
.testimonial-text{
  font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;
  font-size:1rem;
  line-height:1.75;
  color:rgba(240,235,224,0.75);
  font-style:italic;
  flex:1;
}
.testimonial-text em{
  color:var(--off-white);
  font-style:normal;
  font-weight:500;
}
.testimonial-footer{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.2rem;
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);
  padding-top:1.4rem;
  margin-top:auto;
}
.testimonial-avatar{
  width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--surface2);
  border:1px solid var(--blue-border);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  flex-shrink:0;
  font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;
  font-size:1.1rem;
  color:var(--blue);
  letter-spacing:.05em;
}
.testimonial-name{
  font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
  font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--off-white);
}
.testimonial-role{
  font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
  font-size:.54rem;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--steel);
  margin-top:.25rem;
}
.testimonial-stars{
  margin-left:auto;
  color:var(--blue);
  font-size:.7rem;
  letter-spacing:.1em;
}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .testimonials-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}


/* PILLARS */
#pillars{background:var(--black)}
.pillars-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  margin-top:4rem;border:1px solid var(--border);overflow:hidden;
}
.pillar{
  padding:2.8rem 2rem;border-right:1px solid var(--border);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface);
  transition:background .3s;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.pillar:nth-child(3n){border-right:none}
.pillar:nth-child(4),.pillar:nth-child(5),.pillar:nth-child(6){border-bottom:none}
.pillar::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;
  background:var(--blue);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .5s;
}
.pillar:hover{background:var(--blue-dim)}
.pillar:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.pillar-icon{font-size:1.4rem;margin-bottom:1.1rem;display:block;color:var(--blue)}
.pillar-name{
  font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:2rem;
  letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--off-white);margin-bottom:.7rem;
}
.pillar-desc{font-size:1rem;font-style:italic;color:var(--steel-lt);line-height:1.6}


/* IMPACT — cinematic full-bleed section */
#impact{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  min-height:100vh;
  overflow:hidden;
}
/* LEFT — image side */
.impact-img-side{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  /* Must have explicit height for absolute children to work */
  min-height:100vh;
}
.impact-bg{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:url('data:image/png;base64,
